title: What stangent-fsd-reviewer returns (layer 5, D341)
description: Every place the FSD and the code disagree, one finding per difference: a gap (the FSD describes what the code doesn't have), a conflict (the code does it differently) or undocumented (the code has it, the FSD leaves it out). Code checks the section exists, every fsdQuote is word for word inside its section, and every evidence path (and line) exists at the reviewed commit.

section.description: The FSD section id the finding belongs to, exactly as in its heading's brackets; null only for an undocumented screen no section fits.

fsdQuote.description: For a gap or conflict: the FSD sentence(s) concerned, copied word for word from that section. For undocumented: null.

screen.description: For undocumented: the screen's full frontend route as the router resolves it, e.g. /orders/:orderId. Otherwise null.

note.description: One or two sentences: what differs, naming the option, action or rule in plain words.

evidence.description: Code you read that backs the finding: paths relative to the repo root with forward slashes, each with its line (path:line or path:from-to); a path alone for where a missing thing would be.
